newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER SHOWCASE - ANDERLECHT 2 EKEREN 4 - RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE - ANDERLECHT 2 EKEREN 4 - RESULT.

text.p: Ekeren beat Anderlecht 4-2 (halftime 0-1) after extra-times in the final of the Belgian Cup on Sunday.
Ekeren - Johnson 64 own-goal, Christophe Kinet 85, Tomasz Radzinski 91, Gunther Hofmans 95.

Anderlecht: 1-Geert De Vlieger, 2-Tibor Selymes (28-Walter Baseggio 73), 4-Celestine Babayaro, 12-Olivier Doll (30-Stephane Stassin 106), 14-Samuel Johnson, 18-Suad Katana, 5-Johan Walem, 11-Danny Boffin (8-Yaw Preko 66), 13-Bruno Versavel, 10-Par Zetterberg, 22-Oleg Yaschuk

Ekeren: 1-Philippe Vande Walle, 2-Bernard Wegria (5-Ervin Kovacs 53), 6-Mike Verstraeten, 7-Rudi Janssens, 8-Florian Urban, 9-Didier Dheedene, 15-Marc Schaessens (11-Alex Czerniatynski 78), 10-Gunther Hofmans, 14-Christophe Kinet, 12-Edwin Van Ankeren (17-Cvijan Milosevic 46), 13-Tomasz Radzinski
